'''0.23e''' is a minor update for [[Survarium]] that changed weapon drops to only have up to 3 random modifiers and increased the chance of finding weapons and equipment after battle.

==Changelog==
===Gameplay===
* Chance to find ammo and consumables after battle has been lowered
* Chance to find weapons and equipment after battle has been increased
* Cannot find more than one Maps of stashes, rename vouchers, tool sets at a time

===Item properties change===
* The level of [[Vityaz]] SMG lowered to 5
* Extra pockets, pocket size, pouches, artifact containers now cannot be obtained as random characteristics
* The number of maximum possible random characteristics lowered to three. All the items obtained prior to this change have been preserved
* A random characteristic increasing the equipment reliability has been added

===Scavengers===
* Added pocket size to the Backpack with container, Lightweight Bulletproof vest, and Chemical Protective pants

===Fringe Settlers===
* Added pocket size to the Stalker jacket

===Renaissance Army===
* Added pocket size to the Army Bulletproof vest

===Black Market===
* Added pockets size to the "Corsair" Leather pants

===User Interface===
* Changed game login screen
* Changed location loading screen
* Now the names of objects have different colors, depending on their rarity. Blue items have +1 random characteristic, green items +2, and gold items +3
* Added option of setting the parameters of torrent seeding in the lobby
* Temporarily removed red enemy kill indicator

===Bug Fixes===
* Fixed the bug that prevented a match from loading if the application was minimized
